text: Financial Ratios Horizontal Analysis (Trend Analysis) = (Current Year – Prior Year) ÷ Prior Year Vertical Analysis (Common Size) of Income Statement Accounts = Account Balance ÷ Revenues Vertical Analysis (Common Size) of Balance Sheet Accounts = Account Balance ÷ Total Assets Liquidity Ratios: Current ratio = Total current assets ÷ Total current liabilities Quick ratio = (Cash + Short-term investments + Accounts receivable) ÷ Total current liabilities Inventory turnover = Cost of goods sold ÷ Average inventory Accounts receivable turnover = Total revenues ÷ Average accounts receivable Accounts payable turnover = Cost of goods sold ÷ Average payables Days to sell inventory = 365 days ÷ Inventory turnover Days to collect accounts receivable = 365 days ÷ Accounts Receivable turnover Days in payables = 365 days ÷ Payables turnover Cash conversion cycle = Days to Collect A/R + Days to Sell Inventory – Days in Payables Cash to current assets = (Cash + Short-term investments**) ÷ Total current assets Cash to current liabilities = (Cash + Short-term investments**) ÷ Current Liabilities Operating cash flow to current liabilities = Operating cash flow ÷ Average current liabilities Solvency Ratios Debt to equity = Total liabilities ÷ Total stockholders’ equity Interest coverage ratio = (Income before income taxes + Interest expense) ÷ Interest expense Earnings coverage ratio = (Income before income taxes + Interest expense + Rent expense) ÷ (Interest expense + Rent expense) Free cash flow = Operating cash flow – capital expenditures Operating cash flow to capital expenditures = Operating cash flow ÷ capital expenditures PROFITABILITY RATIOS Asset Utilization Cash utilization = Revenues ÷ (Average Cash + Average short-term investments) Accounts receivables utilization = Revenues ÷ Average accounts receivable Inventory utilization = Revenues ÷ Average inventories Current asset utilization = Revenues ÷ Average current assets Noncurrent asset utilization = Revenues ÷ Average noncurrent assets Total asset utilization = Revenues ÷ Average assets Operating Performance Gross profit margin = Gross profit ÷ sales, or total revenues Operating income margin = Operating income ÷ sales, or total revenues Net income margin = Net income ÷ sales, or total revenues Return on Investment Ratios Return on assets = Net income ÷ Average total asset s Return on equity = Net income ÷ Average total equity Leverage = Average total assets ÷ Average equity Equity growth rate = (Net Income – dividends) ÷ Average equity Market Measures Earnings per Share = (Net income – Preferred stock dividends) ÷ Avg. outstanding common shares Price earnings (PE) ratio = Average market price per share ÷ Earnings per share Dividend yield = Dividends per share ÷ Average market price per share Dividend payout ratio = Dividend per share ÷ Earnings per share Market Capitalization = Outstanding common shares X Market price per share
